Let's discuss the progress so far. Please describe what has been achieved, the most promising leads, and what remains open.

I’ll read the research program, route summaries, and progress log, then assess what is established, which leads look strongest, and what remains open. I’ll also record this chat in the boundary-winding history folder.

The latest entries record several concrete results: a necessary jet bound for every height and finite multiplicity, a threshold-preserving differentiation theorem, and rigorous limits on the local winding and later-witness approaches. The tracker still records no theta-specific contradiction. I’m checking the supporting notes to see which results give the next attempt the most useful starting point.

BW-08 looks like the strongest starting point: it turns imaginary-axis information into a sharper restriction on the jets at a hypothetical collision. But the controls expose the central gap—positive sources, exact event cancellations, and the selected bounds can all coexist with a positive threshold. Further progress needs a signed estimate that distinguishes the unchanged theta source. The later-witness routes also need a nonlocal idea, since the new neighborhood theorem rules out all four proposed witnesses near an ordinary double event.

My assessment is that **the program has made substantive progress in necessary conditions, multiplicity handling, and identifying failed approaches. The central theta-specific contradiction remains open.** I read the three requested files, including the 20 October updates, and the supporting result notes and reviews.

The inherited framework is soundly focused: investigate a hypothetical positive threshold \(T=\Lambda\), beyond which all zeros are real and simple. The standard threshold and local splitting facts come from the earlier literature, including [Polymath’s analysis](https://arxiv.org/html/1904.12438v2#S3). The recent work sharpens what such a hypothetical event would have to satisfy.

Five achievements stand out:

1. **BW-08 supplies the strongest new quantitative result.** Write \(h_j=\partial_x^jH(T,a)\) at an exact \(m\)-fold zero. The deflated quantity
   \[
   S_m=\frac{h_{m+1}^{\,2}}{(m+1)^2h_m^2}
   -\frac{2h_{m+2}}{(m+1)(m+2)h_m}
   \]
   now satisfies
   \[
   S_m>L_m(a)>
   \frac{m}{4a^2}+\frac{1}{40\max\{a,20m\}}.
   \]
   This strengthens the mirror-root bound at **every positive height and every finite multiplicity**. Its useful feature is the connection between global information on the imaginary axis and local derivatives at a hypothetical collision. For double events, the result also gives a signed finite-time critical-value estimate with complete remainder bounds. [All-height result](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-3/13_contradiction_analysis/04_boundary_winding/threshold_routes/08_deflated_jet_hierarchy/notes/04_ALL_HEIGHT_MULTIPLICITY_JET_BOUND_20261020.md)

2. **BW-07 proves a meaningful threshold-preserving reduction.** If \(H\) has an \(m\)-fold threshold event, then \(G=\partial_x^{m-2}H\) has a double event at the same point and **the same threshold \(T\)**. That is considerably stronger than the elementary observation that differentiation lowers multiplicity. The necessary imaginary-axis bound survives both parities. However, the source becomes derivative-weighted, and \(G\)’s winding is not automatically \(H\)’s winding. A future exclusion theorem must work for that changed source class. [Differentiation result](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-3/13_contradiction_analysis/04_boundary_winding/threshold_routes/07_multiplicity_reduction/notes/02_DIFFERENTIATED_THRESHOLD_TRANSFER_20261020.md)

3. **BW-06 gives an alternative treatment of higher multiplicity using the original physical jet.** Its complete boundary remainder estimates require derivatives through \(m+2\) and recover the inherited degree
   \[
   W=-\lfloor m/2\rfloor.
   \]
   It also establishes why symmetric absolute-error bounds around the Hermite collision model cannot force zero winding: the allowed class still contains that model. Greater precision within this information class preserves the collision’s degree. [All-multiplicity audit](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-3/13_contradiction_analysis/04_boundary_winding/threshold_routes/06_direct_all_multiplicity/notes/02_ALL_MULTIPLICITY_REMAINDER_AUDIT_20261020.md)

4. **BW-01 has substantially sharpened the obstruction to a generic positivity argument.** The new positive-source family has a genuine positive threshold, exact event cancellations, fixed event height, uniform moment budgets, and both selected imaginary-axis bounds. Nevertheless, its critical-value pair is negative, with normalized curvature unbounded below. This rules out the proposed opposing-sign argument from precisely those inputs. It leaves arguments using additional properties of the complete theta source open. [Positive-source obstruction](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-3/13_contradiction_analysis/04_boundary_winding/threshold_routes/01_local_double_winding/notes/04_EVENT_CONDITIONED_POSITIVE_SOURCE_OBSTRUCTION_20261020.md)

5. **BW-02–05 now have a rigorous local limit.** An explicit forward neighborhood of an ordinary double event contains two real simple roots, no later collision, no negative physical winding on enclosed later domains, and a strictly positive Laguerre expression. This extends the earlier same-point Taylor observation to a whole neighborhood, including moving observation points. Any successful later-witness argument must reach beyond that neighborhood using additional information. [Forward-neighborhood result](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-3/13_contradiction_analysis/04_boundary_winding/threshold_routes/05_later_laguerre_violation/notes/02_QUANTITATIVE_FORWARD_NEIGHBORHOOD_EXCLUSION_20261020.md)

**My first priority would be the BW-08–BW-01 connection, coordinated with the sibling threshold-jet-sign investigation.** It has the clearest quantitative target. At a double event, for a certified \(0<L\le L_2(a)\), the necessary condition is
\[
Q_L=2h_3^2-3h_2h_4-18Lh_2^2>0.
\]
The decisive next milestone would be an independent arithmetic upper estimate forcing \(Q_L\le0\) on a specified candidate class, with all errors included. Even a restricted class would be useful progress. The work has supplied one side of this comparison and the error formulas; the opposing sign is still missing.

A secondary exploratory lead is **a quantitative use of the full imaginary-axis profile and its relation to real-axis cancellations**. The atomic control fails theta’s large-height growth, so the latest obstruction does not close this possibility. But merely imposing the existing lower bound at more heights is insufficient: the Euler-factor controls satisfy that lower bound too. A successful argument would need information that distinguishes the unchanged theta coefficients.

I would keep BW-06 and BW-07 available as two ways to extend a future signed estimate. Which is preferable depends on that estimate: differentiation is useful if its hypotheses survive derivative weighting; the direct physical route avoids that source change. Further multiplicity calculations alone cannot supply the missing exclusion base case.

The later-witness routes currently have less concrete traction. They remain legitimate alternatives, but no same-function arithmetic relation has yet been identified that forces a witness strictly after \(T\). Enlarging the search region does not resolve that missing implication.

The principal open obligations are therefore:

- Obtain an incompatible signed theta estimate, even initially on a restricted event class.
- Extend an actual exclusion across multiplicities, arbitrarily small positive \(T\), and unbounded possible heights.
- Turn analytic error formulas into a new physical exclusion or certificate where numerical work is used.

The [progress register](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-3/13_contradiction_analysis/04_boundary_winding/research-progress/01_THRESHOLD_BOUNDARY_WINDING_PROGRESS_20261019.md) correctly records no new excluded theta region, later witness, improved Newman bound, or computational advantage. The written results have exact control checks and internal same-model reviews; specialist review remains outstanding.

This chat is registered in the requested boundary-winding history folder, with capture of this reply arranged.
Please draft a new research-overview note with a corresponding research-progress note to direct the next round of research.

I’ll draft the next-round overview around the missing signed arithmetic estimate, with concrete milestones and stopping rules, and add a matching progress note that starts from the results already established.

The new overview will make a restricted signed estimate the first target, with a full imaginary-axis-profile argument as an exploratory alternative. Higher-multiplicity and later-witness work will have explicit activation conditions. I’ll also make the new progress note the active register and preserve the existing one as the first-round record.

I’m using the write-page skill’s editorial checks while keeping both notes in the repository’s established Markdown format. The progress note will mark planning as prepared and the new mathematical tasks as not started, with dependencies that prevent a closed unsuccessful attempt from counting as a usable result.

The drafts now specify the opposing sign test, the evidence needed to accept an estimate, and the conditions for extending it. They also keep the existing physical and differentiated-field results distinct. I’m checking the formulas, links, and register handoff before saving them.

Created both notes:

- [Research overview](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-3/13_contradiction_analysis/04_boundary_winding/research-overview/02_THRESHOLD_SIGNED_ARITHMETIC_RESEARCH_PROGRAM_20261020.md): seven work packages prioritizing the opposing signed arithmetic estimate, with controls, acceptance criteria, and stopping rules.
- [Research progress](/Users/ebbaker/Documents/shifted-zeta-positivity/papers/investigations-3/13_contradiction_analysis/04_boundary_winding/research-progress/02_THRESHOLD_SIGNED_ARITHMETIC_PROGRESS_20261020.md): dependencies, evidence requirements, and measurement fields.
